title: Music in Biloxi: Johnny Tobin's band and the beach hotels
summary: Hirsch tells what bands and dances there were in Biloxi, Gulfport and Mobile, with Johnny Tobin's band at the White House hotel, and Easter holidays at Bay St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played
